label: open-rotation-submenu
js: (() => { const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-item]')].find((c)=>c.offsetParent && c.getAttribute('data-menu-item')==='标签旋转'); if(!e) return 'no-item'; e.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover',{bubbles:true})); return 'ok' })()

label: click-left-rotate
js: (() => { const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-item]')].find((c)=>c.offsetParent && c.getAttribute('data-menu-item')==='左旋90度'); if(!e) return 'no-item'; e.click(); return true })()

label: read-board-sin
js: (() => { const el=document.querySelector('[data-testid=label-board-rotator]'); const nums=(getComputedStyle(el).transform.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/)||[])[1]; return JSON.stringify({ rotation: document.querySelector('[data-testid=label-rotation-indicator]')?.dataset.rotation, sin: nums?Number(nums.split(',')[1]):null }) })()
